summary: Version 0.14.0 is live: antipo.watch/portfolio shows a simulated $4,000 CAD envelope guided by the AI signals. Code sizes each order from versioned rules (at most 5 positions, about 20% each, the loss at the stop capped at 10% of the envelope, no leverage), fills it at the next open, closes positions at stop, target, 20 sessions or a sell signal, and computes metrics against XIC with their sample size. Claude wrote the first decisions after the Nov 20 close: buy 9 FTS and 3 DOL at the Nov 23 open. The repository stays public and the model portfolio is public at the owner's word; privacy is deferred to real money. The daily run is scheduled in the working session (weekdays about 16:47 Toronto), first run Nov 23. Also shipped in 0.13.0: the status strip with the last analysis and a denser phone layout.
